description: This file defines the HttpPublishTarget class, which models an HTTP target for message publishing, including methods for parsing target addresses and equality checks.

classes.name: HttpPublishTarget
classes.description: Immutable class representing an HTTP target with method and path, capable of parsing target address strings.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method to use for the request.

methods.name: getPathWithQuery
methods.description: Returns the complete path including query parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an HttpPublishTarget from a string address, parsing method and path, with fallback to POST.

methods.name: splitMethodAndPath
methods.description: Splits the target address into method and path components.
